title: Print the nested relay: an orchestrator per slice, with its own contract
lead: `slicer ai relay` describes an outer session that spawns one orchestrator subagent per slice, and a new `slicer ai relay-orchestrator` prints that orchestrator's whole contract and run report on its own, so neither text depends on a file outside slicer.
findings_note: owner decision, session 2026-10-15: slicer ai relay is the main relay contract; nested-relay trials s290, s279 and idea0 S16, S03
boundary:
**Not in this slice:**
- An `orchestrator` row in the role matrix (`ROLE_NAMES` in `src/slicer/roles.py` has no such role; the owner picks the orchestrator's model at Setup).
- Agent labels and explicit model and effort in `## Every brief` (s293), slivers (s275), the relay board (s294).
- relay-run changes: the ledger living in the worktree, `begin` editing `.slicer/.gitignore`, and a heartbeat with `--task` overwriting the task text.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The owner's `/usage` for the week of 2026-10-15 showed 68% of usage from sessions active 8+ hours and 62% at more than 150k context. The cause was one orchestrating session running slice after slice, its context near 256k. `slicer ai relay` already says to compact or start fresh between slices, but the model cannot compact itself.

Two owner trials on 2026-10-15 ran a nested shape instead: the outer session (the one the owner talks to) spawns one orchestrator subagent per slice, and the orchestrator spawns the implementer, reviewer and gate. Four slices passed and landed (slicer s290 and s279; idea0 adjudicate S16 and pitfight S03). The contract they used lived in a trial prompt outside slicer. The owner decided that `slicer ai relay` is the main relay contract and must give the full contract itself, with the orchestrator's part printed by its own command so the orchestrator never reads the outer session's steps (relay-run begin and end, landing, push). Ownership confusion between the two was the main v1 trial defect.

Trial defects this text fixes: the finish step ran before review; heartbeats overwrote a step's task text; an orchestrator kept itself alive with sleep and monitor loops and left them running after its report; no tie-break when the implementer and reviewer disagreed on a bug; agents carried no environment rules.

sections.heading: Files
Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_AiRelay_Roles_OuterSessionSpawnsOrchestratorPerSlice`: `## Roles` names the outer session and one orchestrator per slice, and names `slicer ai relay-orchestrator`.
- `test_AiRelay_Order_FreshOrchestratorPerSlice`: `## Order` no longer tells one session to run the next slice after compacting, and says the brief starts with running `slicer ai relay-orchestrator`.
- `test_AiRelayOrchestrator_FirstLine_IsContractMarkerWithVersion`: the first line is `Contract: relay-orchestrator ` followed by `slicer.__version__`.
- `test_AiRelayOrchestrator_FinishOnlyAfterPass`: the text says the finish step runs only after `VERDICT: PASS`, and names `handoff` for a handoff project and `done` otherwise.
- `test_AiRelayOrchestrator_Report_StartsWithMarkerEndsWithNothingRunning`: the report shape starts with the marker line and ends with `nothing left running: yes`.
- `test_AiRelayOrchestrator_LeavesOutOuterSteps`: the text does not contain `relay-run begin`, `relay-run end` or `push` as instructions to the orchestrator, except in the rule that forbids them.
- `test_AiRelayOrchestrator_NamesNoHarnessOrOutsideFile`: no "Claude Code", "SendMessage", "ToolSearch", "playbook" or "relay.conf".
- `test_AiRelayOrchestrator_Json_HasOrchestratorKey`: `--json` returns `{"orchestrator": ...}` with the same text.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red, one mutation each.
2. Add `orchestrator_text` and the CLI command, then rewrite `## Roles`, `## Setup` and `## Order` in `relay_text`.
3. Read both outputs end to end in this project (`slicer ai relay`, `slicer ai relay-orchestrator`) and check that together they cover a whole relay with nothing pointing outside slicer.
4. Update the docs and the CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.
- Paste both outputs into the review note.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s296`, branch `feature/s296-nested-relay`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
